name: neon-blob-arena
description: Neon Blob Arena — production multiplayer browser arena (25p/room, dash+knockback physics, scales via room shards)
_note: no workspaces on purpose: nested npm ci fails inside a workspace dir, while server-Docker and Render-FE build from service dirs. Each service pins via its own lockfile.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
